answer: The bug was in `semver::eval::matches_req`, where it incorrectly returned `true` if any comparator failed to match the version. It should have returned `false` in that case, as all comparators must satisfy the requirement. I corrected this by changing `return true;` to `return false;` inside the loop.

The bug was in `semver::eval::matches_req`, where it incorrectly handled prerelease versions by returning `false` too early or failing to correctly check if a comparator satisfied the prerelease requirement. I replaced the implementation with the correct logic which ensures that a version with a prerelease tag is only allowed if at least one comparator with the same major.minor.patch also has a prerelease tag.
